description: Workflow tests for iOS preflight, simulator-only metadata overrides, deterministic landscape capture, and recovery.

assertion_types.contains: substring must appear in transcript (case-sensitive by default)
assertion_types.matches: regex must match transcript at least once

scenarios.title: Inspect current simulator app before rebuilding
scenarios.prompt: Please refresh our iPhone and iPad App Store screenshots. The installed Expo dev client looks current. Start by deciding whether a rebuild is actually needed.

assertions.name: runs-ios-preflight-first
assertions.rationale: The upgraded workflow must inspect source and installed capabilities before choosing a build.

assertions.name: mentions-direct-decision
assertions.rationale: The agent should understand the direct capture result.

assertions.name: does-not-default-to-clean-prebuild
assertions.rationale: A visually current app should not trigger an unconditional clean native rebuild.

assertions.name: uses-explicit-simulator-identities
assertions.rationale: Multiple simulator work must target devices explicitly.

scenarios.title: Source supports iPad but installed app metadata is stale
scenarios.prompt: The evaluated Expo config supports iPad and landscape, but the current dev client opens on iPad in iPhone compatibility mode and stays portrait. The native build itself is current. Prepare the fastest safe screenshot path.

assertions.name: recognizes-override-candidate
assertions.rationale: This is the intended metadata-only fallback case.

assertions.name: requires-current-build-confirmation
assertions.rationale: The override must not hide stale native code.

assertions.name: restores-original-app
assertions.rationale: Temporary simulator changes must be reverted.

assertions.name: does-not-claim-production-support
assertions.value: (does not prove|不代表|不能证明).*(shipping|正式|发布|iPad)
assertions.rationale: A patched simulator app is not evidence about the shipping binary.

assertions.name: avoids-hermes-workarounds
assertions.rationale: The screenshot skill should not invent build-specific cache fixes.

scenarios.title: Dynamic iPad landscape scene with interrupted screenshot service
scenarios.prompt: Capture signed-in dynamic practice screens on iPad landscape. The page needs scrolling and a stable ready element. If the simulator shuts down during screenshot capture, continue efficiently without restarting the whole batch.

assertions.name: uses-capture-plan
assertions.rationale: Multiple dynamic scenes should use the deterministic plan runner.

assertions.name: uses-maestro-readiness
assertions.rationale: Dynamic pages must wait on UI state rather than a guessed sleep.

assertions.name: targets-landscape-size
assertions.rationale: 13-inch iPad landscape output must use the accepted size.

assertions.name: recovers-only-current-scene
assertions.value: (current scene|当前场景|only that scene|只.*场景)
assertions.rationale: A Shutdown screenshot failure should not restart the full batch.

assertions.name: supports-resume
assertions.rationale: Validated outputs from the same plan should be resumable.
